## azldev image list

List images in this project

### Synopsis

List images defined in this project's configuration.

Image name patterns support glob syntax (*, ?, []).
If no patterns are provided, all images are listed.

```
azldev image list [image-name-pattern...] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # List all images
  azldev image list

  # List images matching a pattern
  azldev image list "base-*"

  # Output as JSON
  azldev image list -q -O json
```
